THE DESTINATION

About Chitkul & Kalpa

A scenic Himalayan circuit through the Kinnaur Valley of Himachal Pradesh — from Shimla to Kalpa, Sangla and Chitkul, the last inhabited village on the Indian side of the border. Winding mountain roads, apple orchards and deep valleys set the pace, with the Kinnaur Kailash range watching over every stop.

You'll wander Kalpa's village streets and monastery, spend an evening around a bonfire in Sangla, and finally reach Chitkul to sit by the Baspa River, visit India's last dhaba and last post office, and see how life looks at the edge of the map. All inner line permits are taken care of by us.

WHAT AWAITS YOU

Major Trip Highlights

Visit Chitkul — the last inhabited village of India.

Explore Kalpa — with views of the Kinnaur Kailash range.

Kalpa Monastery — and a stroll through the village streets.

Relax by the Baspa River — in the village of Chitkul.

India's last dhaba and last post office — a classic Chitkul stop.

Sangla Valley & Kamru Fort — the historic fort above the valley.

Apple orchards and deep Himalayan valleys — on the scenic drives.

Bonfire & light music evening — in Sangla, with all inner line permits taken care of.

DAY BY DAY

Your Itinerary

  • Assembly: Assemble at the pick-up point and meet your fellow travellers.
  • Introduction: Meet the team captains for a short and informative tour briefing session.
  • Departure: Board the vehicle and begin your overnight journey to Kalpa.
  • Drive: Enjoy the comfortable night drive with scenic highway views.
  • Dinner Halt: En-route pit stop for dinner (self-paid) before continuing towards the mountains.
  • Arrival: Arrive in Shimla by morning, freshen up and enjoy a fulfilling breakfast.
  • Drive: Start the scenic drive from Shimla to Kalpa along winding Himalayan roads and picturesque valleys.
  • Check-In: Reach Kalpa, check in to your hotel/homestay and freshen up.
  • Evening: Explore Kalpa local market and Suicide Point, and enjoy sunset views over Kinner Kailash.
  • Night: Hearty dinner followed by an overnight stay in Kalpa.
  • Morning: Wake up to a peaceful Himalayan morning and enjoy a warm breakfast.
  • Check-Out: Check out and visit the Kalpa Monastery, followed by a relaxed stroll through the village streets.
  • Views: Soak in the majestic views of the Kinnaur Kailash range.
  • Drive: Scenic drive from Kalpa to Sangla, passing through apple orchards and deep valleys.
  • Evening: Arrive in Sangla by evening, check in to your property and freshen up.
  • Night: Bonfire session with light music, a delicious dinner and an overnight stay in Sangla.
  • Morning: Wake up early to a fresh mountain morning and enjoy breakfast.
  • Drive: Scenic drive to Chitkul — the last village of India.
  • Sightseeing: Visit the iconic Last Dhaba of India, explore Chitkul Monastery and enjoy the riverside views.
  • Relax: Spend time by the Baspa River, admiring the beauty of Chitkul village.
  • Return: In the afternoon, drive back to Sangla, check in again and freshen up.
  • Evening: Explore the local Sangla market, then return to the hotel for a warm dinner and overnight stay.
  • Morning: Wake up, enjoy breakfast and pack your bags.
  • Check-Out: Check out from the property.
  • Sightseeing: Explore the beautiful Sangla Valley, visit Kamru Fort and other nearby local attractions.
  • Departure: By afternoon, board the traveller and begin the return drive towards Delhi.
  • Travel: Overnight journey to Delhi.
  • Arrival: Arrive in Delhi the next morning, marking the end of the trip.
